designationHistory.indexText: After the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission authorized land purchases in 1959, the Fish and Wildlife Service established the Modoc National Wildlife Refuge near Alturas, California, for migratory waterfowl.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Migratory Bird Conservation Act)

designationHistory.note: FWS sources disagree: 1960 (CCP and 2009 fishing CD) versus 1961 (2009 and 2022 hunting CDs). MBCC approval April 8, 1959; first 5,360 acres acquired November 1960.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Modoc NWR Final CCP (2009): MBCC authorized acquisition April 8, 1959; established 1960
FWS ServCat: Compatibility Determination, Hunting, Modoc NWR (2022): established 1961
